title: Shadownet Envelope JWT payload
description: Payload of a shadownet-env+jwt. Defined in rfcs/0001-shadownet.md §8.3. Carried as a JWS-compact string in the A2A message's metadata under key 'urn:shadownet:0.2'. The `from` and `to` fields accept either Shadownames (Shadowname mode) or bare multibase Ed25519 public keys (direct mode).

from.description: Sender identifier — Shadowname or bare multibase Ed25519 public key. MUST equal the JWS header `kid`.

to.description: Recipient identifier — Shadowname or bare multibase Ed25519 public key.

exp.description: Expiry, Unix seconds. Conformance suite enforces exp - iat ≤ 300 (5 minutes) per §8.3.

msgHash.description: sha256:<base64url> hash of canonical JSON of the A2A message with the Shadownet metadata key removed. Computed per §8.4.

text.description: Human-readable message text. RECOMMENDED on every envelope.

intent.description: Application-defined identifier for the kind of interaction. Receivers MUST surface envelopes with unknown intents.

data.description: Application-defined structured payload, schema named by `intent` when present.

creds.description: Credentials presented with this envelope. Included on first contact, or after receiver's cached credentials for this sender expire.
